sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Every screen is glowing, every heart is on display
We fed the machine our secrets, now it tells us what to say
Never read the terms, we just agreed to every line
Gave it half a wish and blamed it for not reading minds

sections.name: Bridge 1
lines: Have you heard this song before?
Looks good, run it, one more encore
Not my fault, accept it all
(beat)
Maybe someone wrote it, maybe no one did
Maybe it’s the average of everything we fed

sections.name: Pre-Chorus 1
lines: And the servers hum like a lullaby
While the numbers climb to the neon sky

sections.name: Chorus 1
lines: We are the ghost in the machine
Living in a world that’s not what it seems
Tokens falling like the rain
Every answer sounds the same
Oh-oh, the lights are fading out
Oh-oh, but no one’s looking down
We’re dancing in the data stream
We are the ghost in the machine

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Merged a million lines and swore that it looked good
Hit regenerate until it said the things it should
Bought a front-row seat to watch the ending of the show
And every time they scored us, a little more would go
